description: Source file defining factory classes and creation functions for various DFT (Discrete Fourier Transform) processors, including generic, FFTW, FFTZ, and AVX2 implementations, with conditional compilation based on available features.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory_generic
classes.description: Factory class for creating generic DFT processor instances.

classes.name: dft_processor_ci16_factory_avx2
classes.description: Factory class for creating AVX2-optimized 16-bit DFT processor instances, enabled on x86_64 architecture.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory_fftw
classes.description: Factory class for creating FFTW-based DFT processor instances with configurable optimization.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory_fftz
classes.description: Factory class for creating FFTZ-based DFT processor instances with maximum optimization.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DFT processor instance based on the factory's configuration.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftw
methods.description: Creates an FFTW factory with specified optimization and planning parameters.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftz
methods.description: Creates an FFTZ factory with maximum optimization.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_ci16_factory_avx2
methods.description: Creates an AVX2-optimized 16-bit DFT processor factory if supported.
